introduction.title: Welcome to Quiz Arena
introduction.description: Quiz Arena is a fun and competitive trivia game where you can have a great time with friends or family. Test your knowledge with questions from different categories, strategic joker usage, and an exciting final round!

objective.title: Game Objective
objective.description: Answer questions correctly to earn points and win the game by achieving the highest score. Think strategically, use your jokers wisely, and leave your opponents behind in the final round!

setup.title: Game Setup
setup.description: What you need to do before starting the game:

steps.title: Step by Step Setup
steps.step1: Click the 'Start New Game' button on the home page
steps.step2: Select the question set you want to play (or create your own set)
steps.step3: Decide whether you want to enable the Final Round
steps.step4: Add the names of teams participating in the game (at least 2 teams required)

setup.note: You can edit question sets, create new sets, or import/export existing sets from the 'Manage Sets' section.

gameBoard.title: Game Board
gameBoard.description: The game board consists of questions in different categories and point values. Each category typically contains questions at 5 different difficulty levels.

categories.title: Categories and Points
categories.description: Each category contains questions at different point values. Higher-point questions are generally more difficult:

howToPlay.title: How to Play?
howToPlay.step1: The team whose turn it is selects a category and point value
howToPlay.step2: The selected question is displayed on the screen
howToPlay.step3: The team can answer the question or use a joker
howToPlay.step4: If they answer correctly, they earn points; if incorrect, the turn passes to the next team

questions.title: Answering Questions
questions.description: Each question must be answered within a specific time. Select and confirm your answer before time runs out.

answerProcess.title: Answering Process
answerProcess.step1: The question and options are displayed on the screen
answerProcess.step3: Select the option you think is correct

correct.title: Correct Answer
correct.description: When you answer correctly, you earn points equal to the question's value and keep your turn. You can build momentum with consecutive correct answers!

wrong.title: Wrong Answer
wrong.description: When you answer incorrectly, you don't lose points, but the turn passes to the next team. The correct answer and explanation are shown.

jokers.title: Jokers
jokers.description: Each team has 3 different jokers they can use. Using jokers strategically plays a major role in winning the game!

fiftyFifty.description: Eliminates 2 wrong options from 4 choices. This increases your chance of answering correctly from 25% to 50%. It's smarter to use on difficult questions, not easy ones.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.description: Transfers the question to another team. If that team answers incorrectly, the turn returns to you and you can answer. Use it to put your opponents in a tough spot!

shield.title: Shield
shield.description: Protects one option. That option won't be eliminated even if the 50/50 joker is used. You can protect it if you know the correct answer.

jokers.limitation: Each team can use a maximum of 1 joker during 3 consecutive question turns. Using jokers wisely and timely is critically important!

finalRound.title: Final Round
finalRound.description: After all questions are completed, if enabled, the Final Round begins. This round can determine the fate of the game!

howItWorks.title: How It Works?
howItWorks.step2: All teams answer the same question
howItWorks.step3: Answers are entered secretly and revealed simultaneously
howItWorks.step4: Teams closest to the correct answer earn points

scoring.title: Scoring System
scoring.description: In the Final Round, you earn points based on your proximity to the correct answer:

winning.title: Winning Strategies
winning.description: Some tips for succeeding in Quiz Arena:

tips.title: Tips for Winning
tips.tip1: Don't save jokers for the last moment - use them strategically on difficult questions
tips.tip2: Try to go for high-point questions but don't take unnecessary risks
tips.tip3: Consider the score situation before the Final Round
tips.tip4: Use the transfer joker on categories where your opponents are weak
tips.tip5: Communicate as a team and make decisions together

winning.goodLuck: Good luck in Quiz Arena! A fun and competitive game awaits you. Be the winning team!
